name: Yanagawa Canal Cruise
description: A punt-boat cruise through the canal town of Yanagawa, a 60-minute ride along the moat of the former castle town, famous for its water-town scenery and eel cuisine.
highlights: A 60-minute punt-boat ride through the canal town
The moat of the former castle town of Yanagawa
A classic rail day-trip from Fukuoka (Nishitetsu)

en.name: Yanagawa Canal Cruise
en.description: A punt-boat cruise through the canal town of Yanagawa, a 60-minute ride along the moat of the former castle town, famous for its water-town scenery and eel cuisine.

en.notes: A single canonical canal-cruise outing: the Shogetsu boarding area is one operator's product, and the town's moat cruise is the stable visitor proposition. Reached by Nishitetsu Tenjin Omuta Line to Nishitetsu Yanagawa Station.
en.reservation: Boats depart on a schedule; check current times. The cruise operator (Yanagawa Kanko Kaihatsu) runs the Shogetsu boarding area.
en.parking: Free parking is available at the boarding-area lots; shuttle buses return from the endpoint.
en.openingHours: Visitor hours and closures vary by date; check the official visitor guidance before visiting.

ja.name: 柳川川下り
ja.description: 柳川の掘割を小船で巡る川下り。かつての城下町の内堀を約60分かけて進み、水郷の風景と名物のうなぎを楽しめます。
highlights: 掘割を小船で60分の川下り
かつての城下町・柳川の内堀
西鉄で福岡から日帰りできる定番
ja.notes: 川下りは一つの定番の体験として扱います。松月乗船場は運航会社の一つで、城下町の掘割クルーズが安定した訪問体験です。西鉄天神大牟田線の西鉄柳川駅からアクセスします。
ja.reservation: 予約・入場条件は変更される場合があるため、訪問前に公式案内をご確認ください。
ja.parking: 可能な限り公共交通機関をご利用ください。駐車場の条件は公式案内をご確認ください。
ja.openingHours: 開館時間・休館日は変更される場合があるため、訪問前に公式案内をご確認ください。
